text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest is bustling with visitors.
While
wandering around campus,
casually checking out
the different
booths...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Yamanin Zephyr in a somewhat
empty area
with a troubled expression
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Another whirlwind... This time, it's
coming from
over there...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer. I was so distracted by the
spring
gales that I didn't see you there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The air is filled with many winds
today—the valley
breeze, the westerly
wind of early spring, a

cherry-blossom-scented breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So many whispers fill the air, I don't
know which
to lend my ears to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There really are a lot of sounds around.
Knowing
how sensitive Yamanin Zephyr
is, I'm not
surprised she finds this
bewildering.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a serious expression. Do you
sense a
Foehn wind blowing down from
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... You're concerned about me? You really are a considerate breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But no, I'm not especially at ease
strolling
through sandstorms.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've been sheltering here from the frosty
gales for
some time... The circling
Cooey-Coos are
watching over me too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look up to see several pigeons. Unlike
everyone
down here on the ground,
they're free to fly
around. As I watch
them circling, a thought occurs
to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You should be able to free yourself from
the
noise if you get some distance from
it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's almost as if a radiant breeze is
blowing
off of you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I don't see why not...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The voices, the singing, the air currents

overhead... They're overlapping,
resonating like a
symphony orchestra.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The Chubby Cheeks and Cooey-Coos
are
frolicking so happily...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Laa, faa-la la, la la. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's little song carries on
the
breeze, echoing gently with a
playful tone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I've had such a relaxing time I
can barely
remember all that earthen
rumbling from before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the Chubby Cheeks were
enjoying
the melody too... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Sparrow
text_block_list.text: Tweet, tweet... Tweet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It sounds like they're ready for
their
afternoon meal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right. We should be able to find
somewhere to
enjoy a peaceful meal
around here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a relaxing time at the Fan Fest
while
listening to a melody of all manner
of sounds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I've had such a relaxing time I
can barely
remember all that earthen
rumbling from before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? This sound... Could a refreshing
breeze be on
its way?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, I thought it was you, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hello to you, too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Miracle. Were you guided here by
the birds
chirping as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That, and I heard some beautiful
singing.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It feels good to stand under this sky—so
good I
almost want to start singing
myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're as refreshing as the
rustling breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to join us? Let the wind
be your
guide, and listen to your heart.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I think if I were singing with you,
I'd really
enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Miracle & Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Laa, laaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their melodic voices float on the breeze
amid the
buzz of the festival. I take a
moment to enjoy the
soft sound of their
harmony.
